st: Steve Austin's Broken Skull Challenge You Lose, You Leave

st: Steve Austin's Broken Skull Challenge Welcome Back to Hell

st: Steve Austin's Broken Skull Challenge Ladies First

The Dancing Dolls head deep into enemy territory to challenge Mobile, Alabama's number one dance squad, the Diamondettes, on their own home turf.
After losing twice in a row to their hometown rivals, the Purple Diamonds, the pressure is on for the Dancing Dolls to take home a first place trophy this week.

st: Out with Abby, In with Chloe - Part 2
d: With Abby away, the moms bring in world-renowned choreographer, Laurieann Gibson. Ex-ALDC member Chloe returns to the competition world to dance against her former teammates.
The group routine focuses on a hot-button issue and provokes two jealous moms to have one of the craziest fights in Dance Moms history!
Laurieann Gibson returns and is more determined than ever to win. With two duets and a group, the girls struggle with stamina as well as their new leader's cut-throat attitude.

Four new bladesmiths step up to the challenge of forging blades using pieces of steel harvested from some monstrous power tools. While some smiths excel under the pressure, others are pushed to the limits of exhaustion in the heat of the Forge.

Four new bladesmiths have their creativity put to the test when they are tasked with making a serrated blade out of only the tools from the table in front of them. They must harvest enough steel to forge the blade.
Four bladesmiths must use the steel from a suit of armor to create a signature blade. The two finalists must create a weapon historically used for both combat and hunting--the boar spear.
